audience: managers of hourly teams who schedule shifts and track time in When I Work

useCases.title: See who works on a day and which shifts are open
useCases.text: The AI lists shifts in a time window with who works when, where and in which position, including open shifts and unpublished drafts.

useCases.title: Find who can take an open shift
useCases.text: The AI lists the users eligible for an open shift, for an existing shift or a planned time, position and schedule. It can also check availability events.

useCases.title: Check clocked hours and who is clocked in now
useCases.text: The AI lists time clock entries with clock-in and clock-out times, length and approval state, or only the open ones. You can sum up hours per employee.

useCases.title: Review time-off requests, swaps and drops
useCases.text: The AI lists time-off requests by date range and status, and shift swaps and drops with the shifts and users involved. You see what waits for a decision.

useCases.title: Create, move or publish shifts
useCases.text: The AI creates a draft or open shift, reassigns or moves a shift after reading it, and publishes drafts so employees can see them.

useCases.title: Request, approve or deny time off
useCases.text: The AI creates a time-off request for a user, or approves or denies a request by changing its status or dates. A new request starts pending.
